_comment: K250-4S driving limits. This file is the safety contract between the human wearing the electrodes and whatever AI/human is driving the box. The engine REFUSES to write power above power.max_percent -- it is enforced in code, not by good intentions. Generate a copy with limits-form.html or edit by hand.
disclaimer: USE AT YOUR OWN RISK. The K250-4S is a high-power e-stim device and its own manual says so. This file makes it controllable, not safe. START LOW AND BUILD -- never open a session at a figure read from someone else's notes. PERCENTAGES DO NOT TRANSFER BETWEEN PAD PLACEMENTS: sensitivity varies enormously by site, and so 38% on a forearm and 38% on a far more sensitive site are neither the same sensation nor the same risk. All calibration in this repo is from ONE body and ONE placement (one placement); use another site and you start again from zero. Never a pad path across the chest/heart. Never on broken, irritated or numb skin. Never while on mains power. Keep loops LOOSE -- circulation at the electrode is the only thing here that can cause real injury. If it burns rather than stings, or the skin doesn't settle back to normal pink, stop. Decide ceilings calm and BEFORE the scene; do not renegotiate mid-scene. The wearer's stop word and the hardware kill switch override everything, including this file.

power.note: Above ~50 reads as pain, which can be wanted but must be deliberate. Raise max_percent only with a spoken, explicit request from the wearer in that session.

speed.note: Multi Adjust. 0 = fastest buzz, 25 = slow heavy thump. Period in seconds ~= value/10000. Usable band for most work is 0-25; past ~35 it thins out.

sweet_spots.hard_drop: speed 25 -> 0 in one step, not a glide

channels.note: auto = drive whatever the box reports as plugged in (CA). Unplugged channels are silently refused by the box; never claim to drive a channel that isn't live.

session.note: If the wearer cannot report (asleep, gagged, alone, not typing), do NOT raise power. Hold the ceiling and prefer longer over harder.

safety.note: no_mains_power is the device manual's own rule: do not play while connected to mains power. loops_loose = circulation at the pads is the one thing that can genuinely injure.

physical_kill_switch.device: hold any knob on the box for 2 seconds -> powers off
physical_kill_switch.note: Give this to whoever is physically present. It works without any software, network, or AI in the loop.
